task.title: Build 62 UPLOADED to App Store Connect, processing VALID (carries the corrected first-send retry fix)

result.summary: Founder authorized proceeding with a replacement build after Build 61's real acceptance test failed the Sep24 Strength confirmation. Bumped the build number to 62 (metadata-only), reran the full affected test suite fresh (282/282 passing) and the release-configuration verifier, archived with Xcode automatic signing, and executed the guarded upload flow. Delivery accepted (d72f257e-a363-4cc7-ba02-95e27f6ce48b), processing state VALID, independently reverified via a separate read-only status check (build-status VALID, import-status VALID, is-on-app-store-connect true). No reauthentication required. Build 62 carries the corrected, fresh-context-reviewed fix (f72551be) that scopes a bounded retry-on-transport-failure to exactly the Strength-reconciliation confirm call site, leaving the shared networking code and every other write command's own recovery logic untouched. No production data mutated, no Server deployed, Sep24 not retried or touched, no device operated.

tests.summary: Full affected suite rerun fresh after the build-number regeneration: 282/282 passing, no regressions. Release-configuration verifier passed (version 1.0/62, AppIcon, HealthKit declarations, exempt encryption).

review.summary: No code changed in this task beyond the metadata-only build-number bump. The uploaded fix (f72551be) was already fresh-context reviewed and approved with no notes in the prior diagnosis task.

zero_write_audit.summary: All pre-upload verification steps (auth-check, dry run, post-upload status check) are read-only by the guarded tool's own design; the only mutating action taken was the single authorized upload itself.

decisions_required: Founder: open TestFlight, accept Build 62, and retry the Sep24 Strength confirmation whenever ready -- the first real-world test of the corrected fix.
